description: This file defines an Android activity named FingerPaint that allows users to draw on the screen with touch input, change paint color, and apply various mask filters like emboss and blur. It includes an inner View class for handling user touch events and rendering the drawing.

classes.name: FingerPaint
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the drawing application, color selection, and menu options.

classes.name: FingerPaint.MyView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, handles drawing based on touch events, maintains a Bitmap and Canvas for persistent drawing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the drawing Paint, mask filters, and the custom view.

methods.name: colorChanged
methods.description: Callback for when the color is changed via the color picker dialog.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with items for color, emboss, blur, erase, and srcAtop modes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to change paint modes and effects.
